notes:
• DriveScope is now on GitHub: this is where updates come from. DriveScope checks a few seconds after it starts and every 6 hours, shows what's new, and installs with one click – or automatically when it's idle, if you switch that on. Every update is verified against its SHA-256 checksum and never installs during a test or erase.
• 📣 Share button: tell someone about DriveScope by email (mail app, Gmail, Outlook), Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, text message (Phone Link), a Facebook / LinkedIn / X post, or a QR code.
• Memory type (SLC / MLC / TLC / QLC) with P/E-cycle ranges, on screen and on the label.
• TRIM status in the header, “TRIM this drive now”, and “Skip TRIM during the format” for drives that disconnect in USB docks.
